SELECT 
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) as total_lots,
                (SELECT SUM(current_weight)/1000 FROM inventory) as total_mt,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_tonbag WHERE status='AVAILABLE') as avail_sublots

SELECT product, COUNT(*) as lot_count, 
                       SUM(current_weight)/1000 as current_mt
                FROM inventory GROUP BY product ORDER BY current_mt DESC

SELECT lot_no, sap_no, bl_no, 
                           current_weight/1000 as current_mt, status
                    FROM inventory 
                    WHERE product = 'LITHIUM CARBONATE'
                    AND current_weight > 0
                    ORDER BY arrival_date DESC

SELECT lot_no, sub_lt, weight/1000 as mt, 
                       outbound_date, status
                FROM inventory_tonbag 
                WHERE status = 'PICKED'
                ORDER BY outbound_date DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', arrival_date) as month,
                       COUNT(*) as lot_count,
                       SUM(initial_weight)/1000 as inbound_mt,
                       SUM(current_weight)/1000 as current_mt
                FROM inventory GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
